scope: joint32 task-0 evaluator versus SmolVLA training objective

verified.evaluator_success_rule: info.is_success or total_reward > 0; done/reward>0 ends rollout
verified.training_action_loss: flow-matching MSE over action horizon and action dimensions after in-episode padding removal
verified.training_target: dataset action chunks, with no native terminal-success label

interpretation.remaining_uncertainty: The supervised action loss does not directly encode environment success or terminal spatial relation, but this is a training-objective limitation rather than a demonstrated implementation bug.
interpretation.decision: Do not claim an inference/evaluator defect and do not repeat terminal-window weighting without a new, explicitly bounded hypothesis. Fold 02 remains locked.

next_gate.recommended: design one new objective intervention only after specifying an offline proxy and a positive-control check
alternatives: stop additional training and report the negative evidence
expand read-only benchmark coverage with the calibrated evaluator
run a bounded release-event objective experiment with offline proxy validation
